# Both sides rename the same user; theirs then kills it (carol) or removes one
# of its keys (dave) under its new name. Our rename wins, so that name does not
# exist after the merge - the removal must land on our name, not be dropped as
# "already removed". Otherwise a squash brings carol back on develop.

sesam-repo admin base.txt

cp $TMPDIR/base.txt s
exec sesam add s --group dev
exec sesam tell --user carol --recipient $CAROL_PUBKEY --group dev
exec sesam tell --user dave --recipient age1tdy2pxsfwpxxe0c9cuwty8zpsv6uuhf4zyug5f9lfl982lh3tctqrw2ll7 --group dev
exec sesam user add-recipient --user dave --recipient 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton+aQGCo+e3c/DPpR6qXCZwBNlh15Aqwua74O/SFA'
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'base: carol, dave with two keys'
exec git branch develop

# develop: rename, then remove under the new name.
exec git checkout develop
exec sesam user rename carol carla
exec sesam kill --user carla
exec sesam user rename dave dan
exec sesam user remove-recipient --user dan --recipient 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton+aQGCo+e3c/DPpR6qXCZwBNlh15Aqwua74O/SFA'
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'develop: rename + remove'

# feature: rename both differently, then merge develop.
exec git checkout -b feature HEAD~1
exec sesam user rename carol cara
exec sesam user rename dave davey
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'feature: rename'

! exec git merge --no-edit develop
stderr 'user carla is cara on our side; killed under that name'
stderr 'user dan is davey on our side; removed the recipients there'
stderr 'user dan is davey on our side; dropped sign-key rotation - run .sesam user regen-sign-key --user davey.'

# git cannot pair carol's sign key rename with develop's delete; keep ours.
exec git add -A
exec git commit --no-edit
exec sesam user ls
! stdout cara
stdout davey
! grep AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton sesam.yml
exec sesam verify
stderr 'Integrity: ok'

# Squashed into develop, carol stays gone and dave's key stays removed.
exec git checkout develop
exec git merge --squash feature
exec git commit --no-verify -m 'squash feature'
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'
exec sesam user ls
! stdout cara
! grep AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton sesam.yml

-- base.txt --
S=BASE
